notes.title: Chesstle Development Update
notes.notes:
Just 3 months until Chesstle releases on February 12!  We wanted to share a little bit about some new features that have been added since the Steam Festival demo version.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38885841/4595b5f3b27349dcc7d351ca8cf6307d43ba17c2.png

Character Upgrades
Every piece you control can be upgraded for better damage and range of movement in exchange for upgrade points you have earned.  1 upgrade point is earned for each completed turn.

Character Special Abilities
Every character gets 1 single use special ability per match.  These specials can quickly turn the tide of a battle.  For instance, the archer has the ability to attack over an ally soldier and the mage can switch places with any allied piece.  Use with caution!

We are also working on

 UI
 Player Statistics
 Steam Integration
 And, of course, bug fixes ;)


Please join us on our Discord Server!
